scripts.text: - Cannot progress quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于你持有的物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Commander Arquien]
Huh? I don't know who you are but don't come in here without permission.
I would like it if you left immediately.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 阿尔奎恩]
嗯？我不知道你是谁，但没有许可不要进来。
请立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Commander Arquien]
Oh, you're that famous {0}?
I should offer you some tea or something but I don't have any tea.
Sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 阿尔奎恩]
哦，你是那位著名的{0}？
我想请你喝点茶什么的，但我没有茶。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Commander Arquien]
I will introduce myself first. I am the founder of the Eden Group and its Commander Arquien Nile Atnad.
My name is complicated so you can just call me Nile.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官 阿尔奎恩]
让我先自我介绍。我是乐园团的创始人，指挥官阿尔奎恩·尼罗·阿特纳德。
我的名字很复杂，你可以直接叫我尼罗。

scripts.text: What brings you to see me?
scripts.translation: 什么事让你来见我？

scripts.text: Your middle name?
scripts.translation: 你的中间名？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Huh, right to the point?
I welcome it.
You know what is the biggest rumor going around town these days?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
嗯，直入主题？
我欢迎。
你知道最近城里流传最大的谣言是什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
It's childhood name my mother gave me when I was young..
It feels better to hear than the name given to me by my damn father, okay?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
那是我母亲在我小时候给我起的乳名...
比起我那个该死的父亲给我起的名字，听起来好多了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Instead of being entertained by other people's personal life, why don't you focus on something else?
They are talking about it a lot these days.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
与其关注别人的私生活，不如关注点别的？
最近大家都在谈论这个。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Right. About the extended excavation of Juperos.
They already excavated as much as they could..
Hasn't it been awhile since people have been turning it over claiming it as some kind of unknown mechanical civilization, a product of scientific power?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
对。关于朱佩罗斯的扩展挖掘。
他们已经挖掘了能挖的部分...
自从人们把它翻来覆去地当作某种未知的机械文明、科学力量的产物以来，已经过了一段时间了吧？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
So.. Why are they promoting and recruiting for the excavation now?
Didn't you see the recruitment notice posted on the squad office?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
那么... 为什么现在又在宣传和招募挖掘人员？
你没看到小队办公室贴的招募告示吗？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
First this is the information we have.
A new passage is discovered in the Juperos area.
So we thought it was another area of Juperos...
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
首先，这是我们要掌握的信息。
在朱佩罗斯地区发现了一条新的通道。
所以我们以为那是朱佩罗斯的另一个区域...

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Surprisingly the newly discovered area is connected to Juperos but it is another site with a different form.
This excavation's goal is that newly discovered area.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
令人惊讶的是，新发现的区域与朱佩罗斯相连，但它是一个形式不同的另一个地点。
这次挖掘的目标就是那个新发现的区域。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
What.. was.. the name. Ah.. I don't know.
It is commonly being referred to as the 'Phantasmagorika' plan.
Rekenber of Lighthalzen is the sponsor of the excavation recruitment and support.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
那个... 叫什么名字。啊... 我不知道。
它通常被称为“幻影魔境”计划。
里希塔乐镇的雷肯贝尔是挖掘招募和支持的赞助人。

scripts.text: So?
scripts.translation: 然后呢？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Huh? Not that interesting?
Should I stop here?
I was prepared because Rahim recommended you.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
嗯？不感兴趣？
我该停在这里吗？
因为拉希姆推荐了你，所以我做了准备。

scripts.text: Please continue.
scripts.translation: 请继续。

scripts.text: Please stop.
scripts.translation: 请停下。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Well, I'm not interested in telling more to somebody who's not interested either.
You're not the only one registered with the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
好吧，我对一个不感兴趣的人也没兴趣说更多。
你不是唯一在乐园团登记的人。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I should ask Rahim to recommend me someone else.
I get it so go on along now.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
我应该让拉希姆给我推荐别人。
我明白了，现在走吧。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Sure. We also wanted to participate in the Phantasmagorika.
Of course under the name of Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
当然。我们也想参与幻影魔境。
当然，是以乐园团的名义。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
... What, you're interested again now?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
... 什么，你现在又感兴趣了？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
As you wish.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
如你所愿。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Should I continue talking?
We also wanted to participate in the Phantasmagorika.
Of course under the name of Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
还要继续说吗？
我们也想参与幻影魔境。
当然，是以乐园团的名义。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Although we operated mostly as a broker between clients and implementers
we can't be stuck with Morocc forever.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
虽然我们主要充当客户与执行者之间的中介，
但我们不能永远被摩洛哥束缚住。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Rahim argued that we can advance further by using this as an opportunity.
Through this work we have during that time become acquainted and networked with many adventurers and strong warriors like you..
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
拉希姆认为，我们可以利用这个机会更进一步。
通过这项工作，我们在那段时间里结识了许多冒险者，以及像您这样强大的战士，建立了人脉。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I'm saying we want to use your manpower. Aren't we pros at introducing human resources? Ahahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
我的意思是，我们想利用你们的人力。我们不是最擅长介绍人力资源的吗？啊哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Truthfully the infamously haughty Rekenber requested us.
They are in need to a lot of manpower so they need us to broker.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
说实话，是那些臭名昭著、傲慢的雷肯贝尔找上了我们。
他们急需大量人力，所以需要我们来做中介。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Not a bad proposition. Honestly it's a good opportunity.
We introduce people and get paid, you work and get paid.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
这提议不错。老实说，这是个很好的机会。
我们介绍人并收取费用，你们工作并获得报酬。

scripts.text: Wanting to participate in Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation: 想要参与幻影魔境？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
It can be summarized as such.
Basically you're participating in the site excavation work but
you can help with a personal favor as well.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
可以这样概括。
基本上你是参与现场挖掘工作，
但也可以顺便帮个私人忙。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
If you participate in the excavation team can you confirm something for me?
You will hear more details from Rahim..
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
如果你加入挖掘团队，能帮我确认一件事吗？
更多细节你可以从拉希姆那里听到。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I want one thing.
There are several excavation teams and organizations currently participating in the Phantasmagorika excavation.
I would like you to work in an excavation team Rahim introduces.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
我有一件事。
目前有几个挖掘团队和组织正在参与幻影魔境的挖掘。
我希望你加入拉希姆介绍的那个挖掘团队。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
And, as your working with the excavation team ^4d4dffask about the Last Exploration^000000.
Rahim will give you the details.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
而且，当你与挖掘团队一起工作时，^4d4dff调查一下“最后的探索”^000000。
拉希姆会给你详细说明。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
It's the next room so you can get the details there.
Also, if you find out anything let me know. You don't need to tell anybody else.
Come right back here. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
就在隔壁房间，你可以去那里了解详情。
另外，如果你发现任何情况，告诉我。不需要告诉其他人。
直接回到这里来。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Rahim is waiting in the next room.
He is the one who started this work first so get the details from him.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
拉希姆在隔壁房间等着。
他是这项工作的发起人，所以从他那里获取细节。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hey, are you beginning in earnest now?
Then what are you doing here? Run off now!
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
嘿，你是真的要开始行动了吗？
那你在这里干什么？现在就走！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Run off and look at that stuck-up doctor for me.
Ah....He's not starving and being weak is he? Huh?
Observe and tell me.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
快跑，替我看看那个傲慢的医生。
啊……他没有挨饿，也没有变弱吧？嗯？
观察一下，然后告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Now-! Go now!
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
现在-！快走！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
How is work on the excavation team?
..Rahim is doing well right?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
挖掘团队的工作怎么样？
……拉希姆还好吧？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
... The old man. He's doing well? What? Is he? Maybe it's funny and childish to be like this at this point.
Darn! I don't know. Get out!
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
……那个老人。他好吗？什么？是吗？也许到了这个时候还这样想有点可笑和幼稚。
该死！我不知道。滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Huh? What's going on?
If it's about reports, I am getting them through Luke.
I heard you are working pretty hard?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
嗯？怎么回事？
如果是关于报告的事，我是通过卢克收到的。
听说你工作很努力？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Thanks to that your position with the Atnad excavator and Eden Group are getting better so it is great.
... It would better if it wasn't for my damn father.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
多亏了你，你在乐园团和挖掘者团队中的地位越来越高，这很好。
……如果不是因为我那个该死的父亲，情况会更好。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Anyway, why did you come?
Did you find out about the Last Exploration?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
总之，你来这里做什么？
你查到了关于“最后探索”的事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
He told you to being something back?
What, is that?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
他让你带什么东西回来？
什么？那是？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I am not sure what you're talking about but..
He told you to bring it back?
Why would I?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
我不确定你在说什么，但是……
他让你把它带回来？
我为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Tell me exactly what it is you have to take back.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
告诉我，你具体要带回来的是什么。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hum...Record Player?
He actually remembers there was something like that in the house?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
嗯……记忆音盘？
他真的记得家里有这么个东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I don't know how this will affect your position but...
I don't think so?
Reject!
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
我不知道这会影响你的地位，但是……
我不觉得会吧？
拒绝！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Darn it.
Okay. I got it.
I have the record player.
Give me Memory Records if you have them!
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
该死。
好吧。我知道了。
我有记忆音盘。
如果你有的话，把记忆音盘给我！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
What? No?
Well.. this is bad,
want to get a Record player.
Brings the Memory Record player!
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
什么？没有？
那……这就麻烦了，
想要得到记忆音盘。
把记忆音盘带来！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hm.. is this it?
Looks like it will fit.
You mean this came out of that place?
But this might be a bit tough.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
嗯……是这个吗？
看起来能装进去。
你是说这东西是从那个地方出来的？
但这可能有点棘手。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
My stupid father didn't care about the things in the house because he was too busy outside.
Can't he didn't notice something like this.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
我那个愚蠢的父亲太忙了，根本不在乎家里的东西。
他不可能注意到这种东西。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Humph. Unfortunately I think somebody took this Memory Record apart on purpose.
It won't run with just one piece.
I need at least five.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
哼。不幸的是，我觉得有人故意拆开了这个记忆音盘。
只有一片是运行不了的。
我至少需要五片。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hm..
Okay. Then let's do this.
I will go to the excavation site with the record player.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
嗯……
好吧。那就这么办。
我会带着记忆音盘去挖掘现场。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
You collect the remaining Memory Records during that time.
Somebody probably did it on purpose so pieces will be scattered around.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
在那期间，你去收集剩下的记忆音盘。
有人可能是故意拆开的，所以碎片会散落各处。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
You understood, what I said?
Then let's see each other in Verus.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
你明白我说的话了吗？
那我们在维鲁斯见。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Collect ^4d4dff5 things like memory records^000000.
They will be hidden in places around Verus somewhere, so good luck.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
收集^4d4dff5像记忆音盘这样的东西^000000。
它们会藏在维鲁斯周围的某个地方，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
..You.. Me going to the excavation site..
Keep it a secret from my father..
..Hm..
Well, no special reason to keep it a secret.
Do as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
……你……我去挖掘现场……
对我父亲保密……
……嗯……
好吧，没有特别理由要保密。
随你便。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I'm not going there myself because of curiosity.
I am a busy person myself.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
我自己不会去那里，因为好奇。
我自己也很忙。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I am sorry but you cannot enter further without approval.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
很抱歉，未经批准，您无法进入更深处。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
You are a member of the Atnad excavation team.
I will guide you inside.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
您是阿特纳德考古队的一员。
我会为您引路。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Sh. I'm just here as escort.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
嘘。我只是负责护卫的。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
I am the chairman of Rekenber.
I invited you to come.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔会长]
我是雷肯贝尔的会长。
是我邀请你们来的。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
I have heard a lot and am familiar with the activities of the Atnad excavation team.
A lot of big results are being achieved as a corporation.
Thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔会长]
我听说过很多，也很熟悉阿特纳德考古队的活动。
作为公司，你们取得了很大的成果。
谢谢你们。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
The reason I have invited you....
You may already know as team leader Dr. Atnad.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔会长]
我邀请你们来的原因是……
作为队长，您应该已经知道了，阿特纳德博士。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Could it be......
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
难道说……

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
It is what you are predicting.
It's about the Memory Records contents you have been working so hard to collect.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔会长]
正是您所预料的。
关于你们辛苦收集的记忆音盘的内容。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
We plan to dispose of the content known through the Memory Records and the word of the Memory Records themselves as if it never happened.
I hope you will cooperate with this.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔会长]
我们计划销毁通过记忆音盘获知的内容，以及记忆音盘本身，仿佛这一切从未发生过。
希望您能配合。

scripts.text: What did you say?
scripts.translation: 你说什么？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
If this information is leaked outside, the corporation is willing to treat your excavation team with courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔会长]
如果这些信息泄露出去，公司愿意以礼相待，照顾你们的考古队。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Treatment? Courtesy?
What are you trying to sell!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
照顾？以礼相待？
你们想干什么！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What is the reason people can't know about the past of the city buried underground!
Who are you to act like this!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
为什么人们不能知道埋在地下的城市的历史！
你们凭什么这样做！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
We are people who look to truth and fact through the past.
Are you trying to block your eyes and ears now?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我们是通过过去来追寻真相和事实的人。
你们是想掩耳盗铃吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
Instead we will give you sole rights to everything related to the Memory Records.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
相反，我们将授予你们与记忆音盘相关的一切的独家权利。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What are you talking about now?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你们现在又在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
We do not mean cease your work.
We are not saying discard all the information you have found.
However, what we want is...
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
我们并不是要停止你们的工作。
我们也不是说丢弃你们发现的所有信息。
但是，我们想要的是……

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
I want to bury the story between myself, and you.
Do you not remember?
We are probably acquainted.
Although I did make some preparations.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
我想把我和你们之间的故事埋藏起来。
你不记得了吗？
我们可能认识。
虽然我做了一些准备。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
... Now that I think you do look familiar..
Juperos!
Yes, I saw you at Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
……现在想想，你确实看起来很熟悉。
朱佩罗斯！
是的，我在朱佩罗斯见过你。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That time you did.. in the crack that looked like a passage...
......You attacked me!
You bastard.. Because of you..!!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
那次你……在那个看起来像通道的裂缝里……
……你袭击了我！
你这个混蛋……因为你……！！

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Hoho. I meet the main culprit of my family's destruction.
Is this meant to be?
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
呵呵。我竟然见到了导致我家破人亡的罪魁祸首。
这就是命运吗？

scripts.text: What do you mean family's destruction?
scripts.translation: 家破人亡是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
The time, that accident or whatever you call it.
When I found a seemingly artificial obstacle during the Juperos excavation..
Ian suddenly disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
就是那次，不管你们管它叫事故还是什么。
在朱佩罗斯发掘时，我发现了一个看似人造的障碍物……
伊恩突然就消失了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I found myself in a motel room in Juno when I came to.
I didn't even know how much time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我醒来时发现自己躺在朱诺的一家汽车旅馆里。
我甚至不知道过了多久。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
The man went to look around the excavation site and didn't return in over a week...
What do you think we thought?
We wondered if he suffered an unfortunate accident.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
那个男人去发掘现场四处查看，却超过一周没有回来……
你觉得我们会怎么想？
我们以为他遭遇了不幸的事故。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
My teeth gnash whenever I think of that time.
Because of the vague memories of that time..
I clung to Juperos like a mad man.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
每当想起那段时光，我就咬牙切齿。
因为对那段时间模糊的记忆……
我像疯子一样执着于朱佩罗斯。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
......I am sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
……对此我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You're the one who attacked me, right?
What happened to the week I lost.
...After that, I chased after an illusion I wasn't sure was a dream or hallucination.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
袭击我的人就是你，对吧？
我失去的那一周发生了什么。
……在那之后，我追逐着一个不知是梦还是幻觉的幻影。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I blindly went around Juperos.
Lost my team members.. even forgot that I had a family and a home to go back to.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我盲目地在朱佩罗斯游荡。
失去了团队成员……甚至忘记了自己还有家人和家可以回去。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
...Why did you?
Please tell me. Chief Secretary.
Why did you attack father?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
……为什么？
请告诉我，首席秘书。
为什么要袭击父亲？

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
That is.. because the doctor saw something he shouldn't have at the time.
Verus city was not ready to be revealed.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
那是……因为医生当时看到了不该看的东西。
维鲁斯城还不具备被揭露的条件。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What?! Verus!!!
So what I found then was a passage to Verus?!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
什么？！维鲁斯！！！
所以我当时发现的，是通往维鲁斯的通道？！

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
No no wait wait.
Father, speak to me for a moment.
I just need a moment.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
不不，等等。
父亲，请和我对话一会儿。
我只需要一点时间。

scripts.text:
I don't know what is happening.
Should we listen to the Atnads first?
scripts.translation:
我不知道发生了什么。
我们要先听听阿特纳德家的话吗？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
.... What can we do.
We will wait. Please speak.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔会长]
……我们该怎么办呢。
我们就等着吧。请说。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
A chairman's job is to do nothing in times like this.
... That is it.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔会长]
会长的职责，就是在这样的时刻什么都不做。
……就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
....
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
……

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
The chairman has waited for a long time.
I as well.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
会长已经等了很久了。
我也是。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
Are you taken aback?
So have I. I did not think people's lives to be tied together as so.
Anyway that young lady...
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
你们感到惊讶吗？
我也一样。我没想到人们的命运会如此紧密相连。
总之，那位年轻女士……

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
.. has a good strong attitude.
True.
Please speak.
I will wait.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
……有着非常坚定的态度。
确实如此。
请说。
我会等着。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
I see it is my turn again.
I will formally introduce you.
The last survivor of Verus City, Tatio.W.00H-1.
Simply call him Tatio.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
看来又轮到我了。
请允许我正式介绍一下。
维鲁斯城的最后幸存者，塔蒂奥。W.00H-1。
请称呼他为塔蒂奥。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Not revealing the contents of the Memory Records by the corporation.
Attacking you at Juperos was all because I wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
我不会透露公司记忆音盘的内容。
在朱诺攻击你们，完全是因为我想这么做。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
To tell you this I have no choice but to reveal my identity.
I have prepared for this but.. it does not feel great.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
为了告诉你们这些，我不得不揭露自己的身份。
虽然我已经做好了准备...但感觉并不好。

scripts.text: Everybody seems frozen by the massive news.
scripts.translation: 似乎所有人都被这巨大的消息震住了。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
I am the Tatio in the Memory Records you have discovered.
And Atnad is Lasse Atnad, the great-grandfather of Dr. Atnad.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
我就是你们发现的记忆音盘中的塔蒂奥。
而阿特纳德是拉塞·阿特纳德，阿特纳德医生的曾祖父。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Lasse is one of the people who made me, and a friend.
I wanted to protect Verus, which is home to my undead machine body...
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
拉塞是制造我的人之一，也是我的朋友。
我想保护维鲁斯，那是我的不死机械之躯的故乡...

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
I have committed that discourtesy that the time.
And on top of that, I had a hand on hiding what the doctor saw........
I manipulated his memory a bit.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
我在那时犯了那个无礼的错误。
而且，我还参与了隐瞒医生看到的事情........
我稍微操纵了他的记忆。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
That is why you have that one week gap.
I took care of you for four days and sent you to the motel in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
这就是为什么你们有一周的空白。
我照顾了你四天，然后把你送到了朱诺的旅馆。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
I would not have done that if I knew you were a descendant of Lasse.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
如果我知道你是拉塞的后代，我就不会那样做了。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Verus city a long.. long. Time ago was once side by side with Juperos..
No surpassed it as a great city of science with a scientific civilization.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
维鲁斯城在很久...很久以前，曾与朱诺并驾齐驱..
甚至作为一个拥有科学文明的伟大城市超越了它。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Although an unfortunate accident turned it the way it is now.
I did not die because I was made of machines so I just watched over Verus.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
虽然不幸的事故让它变成了现在的样子。
我没有死，因为我是由机器构成的，所以我只是守护着维鲁斯。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
This story. Does the chairman know?
Wait. He already knows I bet. Isn't that why he called us here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
这个故事。会长知道吗？
等等。他肯定已经知道了。不然他为什么叫我们来这里。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
That is right.
The chairman knows of me and the Verus City secrets.
Only two in the whole world knew of this secret.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
是的。
会长知道我和维鲁斯城的秘密。
全世界只有两个人知道这个秘密。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Ah, No. One of the founders, Janet Zerter knows of this as well.
Also one of the descendants of Verus City.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
啊，不。创始人之一，珍妮特·泽特也知道这个。
她也是维鲁斯城的后裔。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
.....Do you now understand my previous proposal?
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
.....你现在明白我之前的提议了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Oh oh well...
Although open, Verus City is still something you want to protect ..I see.
That is why the Memory Records...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
哦，好吧...
虽然开放，但维鲁斯城仍然是你想保护的东西..我明白了。
这就是为什么记忆音盘...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Then this doesn't apply to the other data in the city?
You're trying to hide it to prevent your's and my name being revealed and becoming a public issue, right?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
那么这不适用于城市中的其他数据？
你试图隐藏它，以防止你和我被揭露并成为公共问题，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
The quantum level core technology unsuitable for this world's civilization has already been discarded.
Just like how lethal weapons are not put in the hands of children.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
不适合这个世界文明的量子级核心技术已经被丢弃。
就像致命武器不会放在孩子手中一样。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Although most of the data has been lost by accident...
You will probably gain plenty with what is now remaining.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
虽然大部分数据因事故而丢失...
但凭借现在剩下的，你可能会获得很多。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Why did you reveal it?
Should have wrapped it tightly instead.
Like you did to me.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你为什么揭露它？
应该把它紧紧包裹起来。
就像你对我做的那样。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
..To be honest, the first reason is that I could not easily approach the laboratories because of the energy storms during the time
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
说实话，最初的原因是因为当时能量风暴肆虐，我无法轻易接近实验室。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
And because although I do not know the reason the energy storms disappeared and
I assessed it as not being too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
虽然我不知道能量风暴为何消失，但我评估认为现在的危险程度已经不高了。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
The right time to reveal it has came.
This place has also come to understand what is science and engineering.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
揭示真相的时机已经成熟。
这里的人们也开始理解科学与工程了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
.. Something is doubtful, but okay.
I guess I should be satisfied at even having this kind of opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
虽然有些疑点，但算了。
能有这样的机会，我也该满足了。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
I thank you for understanding.
I will give you sole rights to the Memory Records.
However the revealing of information and timing must be decided here.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
谢谢你的理解。
我将授予你记忆音盘的独家权利。
但信息的公开方式和时机，必须由这里决定。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
And... In order to avoid affecting our descendants
we should keep it a secret between us as well.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
还有...为了避免影响我们的后代，
这件事我们也必须守口如瓶。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I understand that.
Then I will handle the collecting of the Memory Records as I have been until now.
I will decide to report directly or not through you.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我明白了。
那么，我会像往常一样负责收集记忆音盘。
至于是否直接向你汇报，由我决定。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That is it, right?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
就是这样，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
That is right.
In reality there is not much change to the actual work.
Ah also...
For working diligently as a member of the Atnad excavation team..
{0} I will give you a small reward.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
没错。
实际上，具体的工作内容并没有太大变化。
啊，对了...
鉴于你作为阿特纳德挖掘队成员辛勤工作...
{0} 我会给你一点小奖励。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
The contents of the Memory Records are precious memories to me.
...It is like going through my diary. So I hope you take care in the future.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
记忆音盘的内容对我来说是珍贵的回忆。
...就像翻看我的日记一样。所以希望你今后能妥善保管。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
...I hope everything goes smoothly with this...
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奥]
...希望一切顺利...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Have you arrived now?
It seems everybody has gathered.
So, let's see what it was you had to say to everybody.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
你终于到了？
看来大家都聚齐了。
那么，让我们听听你有什么要对大家说的。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So, what do you want to say?
What is it that you cut me off in this important moment.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
所以，你想说什么？
为什么在这个关键时刻打断我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
We keep losing the point.
Shouldn't you ask why he attacked me first.
Let's please listen to what he has to say. Daughter.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我们总是抓不住重点。
你不该先问问为什么他攻击我。
请听听他有什么要说的。女儿。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It is confusing to hear a surprising story at once but
At the same time it's cathartic.
Hm.. I see. I see.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
一下子听到这么惊人的故事确实让人困惑，
但同时也让人如释重负。
嗯.. 我明白了。我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What that man just said, was the incident of your disappearance?
The reason why you were running around outside for years.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
刚才那个男人说的，是你失踪的那件事？
也就是你多年来在外奔波的原因。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
No.. it's not that..
The time I was with the doctor was only four days.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘书]
不.. 不是那样..
我和医生在一起的时间只有四天。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
Before you said you were stuck somewhere for a week!
And running around like you were possessed by a ghost!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
你之前说你在某处被困了一周！
还像被幽灵附身一样到处乱跑！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That.. that..!
Don't treat my passion for my field like a runaway ghost!
At the time I thought I was going to find something about my grand-grandfather..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
那.. 那..！
别把我的专业热情当成失控的幽灵！
当时我以为能发现一些关于我曾祖父的事情..

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The place I saw.. The memory I had of that place...
.....
...?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
我看到的景象.. 我对那个地方的记忆...
.....
...？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Wait a minute. Are you blaming me now?
I sent letters home, but you were the one who didn't reply!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
等一下。你现在是在怪我吗？
我明明寄了信回家，可你才是那个不回复的人！

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
All the letters were sent back because the address wasn't clear!
Why are you talking big!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
那些信全都因为地址不清被退回来了！
你凭什么这么大声！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
And didn't you sell the house and sent all my letters back!
You couldn't wait a few years so sell the house and disappear?!
What do you have to say for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特纳德]
而且不是你卖掉了房子，把我的信全都退回来吗？
你就不能多等几年，非要卖房然后消失吗？！
你还有什么好说的！

scripts.text:
The situation is overheating due to the fight between father and daughter.
Aures and the secretary giving embarrassed looks.
scripts.translation:
父女俩的争吵让气氛变得火热。
奥雷斯和秘书尴尬地交换着眼神。

scripts.text: Should the table be turned over?
scripts.translation: 掀翻桌子？

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What's that sound..
An..anyway isn't that secretary the main instigator of this whole incident?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
那是什么声音..
啊..总之，那个秘书不就是这次事件的主要始作俑者吗？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Now you are here.
Sit here comfortably.
Although it might uncomfortable to sit on the corporation toilet.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
既然你来了。
就坐在这里吧。
虽然坐在公司的厕所上可能不太舒服。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It is amusing to see those two together.
Seems you cannot trick blood.
Seeing how they talk alike.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
看到这两个人在一起真是有趣。
看来血缘是无法欺骗的。
看他们说话的方式就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I loathe fighting but.. It is fun to see them together. Yes.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷斯]
我讨厌打架，但..看着他们在一起挺有意思的。是的。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
Let's see if you gathered all of us to give us some bombastic story.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
让我们看看，你是不是把我们召集起来只是为了讲一些夸张的故事。

奥雷斯和秘书尴尬地交换着眼神。

scripts.text: Should the table be turned over?
scripts.translation: 掀翻桌子？

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What's that sound..
An..anyway isn't that secretary the main instigator of this whole incident?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
那是什么声音..
啊..总之，那个秘书不就是这次事件的主要始作俑者吗？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
.......Let's keep listening to that secretary guy.
If give me nonsense I'm going to flip this company over.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
.......让我们继续听那个秘书的家伙说吧。
如果他再胡言乱语，我就把这家公司掀翻。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
So he means we can know the embarrassing past of the secretary by collecting and listening to the Memory Records?
That is kind of interesting.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
所以他的意思是，我们可以通过收集并聆听记忆音盘，来了解那个秘书的尴尬过去？
这还挺有趣的。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What are you doing?
Let's go back now.
To the city that was too good for its own good.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔奎恩]
你在干什么？
我们现在就回去。
回到那个因为太好而自食其果的城市。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Investigations are supposed to be done calmly...
scripts.translation:
[杜]
调查应该是冷静进行的...

scripts.text:
[Du]
Isn't this a complete mess?
Whew, barely got in!
I hate these access protocols.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
这简直是一团糟！
呼，勉强进来了！
我讨厌这些准入协议。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Right!
Our job is to investigate that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
没错！
我们的任务就是调查那个！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I think it's an essential protocol needed for safety.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我认为这是为了安全所必需的协议。

scripts.text:
[Du]
You guys, look at this!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
你们看这个！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Isn't this a complete mess?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
这简直是一团糟！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hey...
Didn't you just say that?
scripts.translation:
[马克]
嘿...
你刚才不是才这么说的吗？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Hey.
Forget about that and let's start on the investigation instead.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
好了。
别管那些了，我们开始调查吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
By the way I think I know why only this place was sealed off.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
顺便说一下，我觉得我知道为什么只有这个地方被封锁了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
There are no intact buildings and the cracks on the ground are much more severe compared to other areas...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
这里没有完好的建筑，而且地面的裂缝比其他地方严重得多...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Not to mention these monsters...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
还有这些魔物...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
It seems they are only found here so something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
它们似乎只在这里出现，肯定有什么不对劲...

scripts.text:
[Du]
Right!
Our job is to investigate that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
没错！
我们的任务就是调查那个！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Come to think of it the people passing by earlier did say there is an incredible device in the center...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
说起来，刚才路过的人说中心有一个不可思议的装置...

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Then let's investigate that part first.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
那我们先去调查那一部分吧。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Coooooooooolll!!!!
See this?
Right here!!!!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
太酷了！！！！
看到没？
就在这里！！！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Doesn't it look like something will go swirly?!
Haaa!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
看起来马上就要旋转起来了？！
哈啊！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
I wish I could take the whole thing to my laboratory!
I can only watch on...
scripts.translation:
[水果]
我真想把整个东西都带回我的实验室！
但我只能看着...

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
So I was thinking...
I was busy here so I haven't been able to go down to the underground bunker they say is right underneath.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
所以我在想...
我刚才一直在这里忙，没能去下面看看。听说就在正下方有一个地下碉堡。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
你想去吗？

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
It isn't common to have someone tell you all the investigation points, right?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
有人把所有调查点都告诉你，这可不常见吧？

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
I am not asking you to work for free either!
If you bring back interesting results there will be rewards!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
我也没让你白干！
如果你带回有趣的结果，会有奖励的！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Eh...

[Fruit]
Yahoo!!!
If you go in a little ways there will probably be someone to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
耶！！！
进去走一段路，应该会有人指引你的。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
I will be expecting you to bring back lots of fun stuff.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
我等着看你带回很多有趣的东西。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Yahoo!!!
If you go in a little ways there will probably be someone to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
耶！！！
进去走一段路，应该会有人指引你的。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
I will be expecting you to bring back lots of fun stuff.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
我等着看你带回很多有趣的东西。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
How, is there any progress in the investigation?
Although it is an underground bunker, the scale is not a joke!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
喂，调查有进展吗？
虽然是个地下碉堡，但规模可不小！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Wouldn't it be lost?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
不会弄丢吧？

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务 -

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Aarrghhhh!!!
Amazing!!!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
啊啊啊啊！！！
太棒了！！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
So? So? Then what?
Come on! Tell me more!!!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
然后呢？然后呢？后来怎么样了？
快说！继续说！！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Hm... Is there anything more interesting?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
嗯...还有什么更有趣的事情吗？

scripts.text: Trade goods.
scripts.translation: 交易物品

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
I will give you equipment in return for 17 intact machine components!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
用17个完整的机械零件，我会给你装备作为交换！

scripts.text: Runaway Chip
scripts.translation: 爆走芯片

scripts.text: Broken Chip 1
scripts.translation: 破损芯片 1

scripts.text: Broken Chip 2
scripts.translation: 破损芯片 2

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Runaway Chip is HIT + 50, FLEE + 50, MSP - 50%
scripts.translation:
[水果]
爆走芯片：命中 + 50，移花接木 + 50，魔法速度 - 50%

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
When equipped together with Broken Chip 1 and Broken Chip 2, you get unlimited movement acceleration.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
与破损芯片 1 和破损芯片 2 同时装备时，可获得无限移动加速。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
ATK and MATK + 50. If helmet refinement is at 9, it has an affect of MSP + 50%, MHP + 10%.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
攻击和魔法攻击 + 50。如果头盔精炼度达到 +9，则拥有魔法速度 + 50%，魔法HP + 10% 的效果。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Broken Chip 1 has STR + 4. If equipped with Broken Chip 2, it has a STR + 8, INT+ 8 affect.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
破损芯片 1：力量 + 4。若与破损芯片 2 同时装备，则拥有力量 + 8，智力 + 8 的效果。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Broken Chip 2 has INT + 4. If equipped with Broken Chip 1, it has a STR + 8, INT+ 8 affect.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
破损芯片 2：智力 + 4。若与破损芯片 1 同时装备，则拥有力量 + 8，智力 + 8 的效果。

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兑换

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Not enough!!!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
不够！！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Is this not what you wanted?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
这不是你想要的吗？

scripts.text:
This part is very pristinely preserved compared to the upper parts.
But this disgusting smell....
scripts.translation:
与上层相比，这里的保存状况非常完好。
但这股令人作呕的气味……

scripts.text:
[Mark]
The Undead not seen in other areas can be easily seen in this zone.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
在其他区域看不到的不死族，在这个区域很容易看到。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
If you look at the structure of this place...
Or the condition, I think this place was built to be used as a bunker.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
看看这里的地形结构...
或者看它的状况，我觉得这个地方是作为碉堡建造的。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then that means... The Undead...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
那么也就是说... 那些不死族...

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Eeeeeeeeeeek!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
It might be a good idea to calm down first...and look around thoroughly.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
先冷静下来...然后仔细看看周围的情况。

scripts.text: It might be a good idea to calm down first...and look around thoroughly.
scripts.translation: 先冷静下来...然后仔细看看周围的情况。

scripts.text:
[Du]
O...o...o...okay!
Thi...thi...this stuff..... is...is nothing...
scripts.translation:
[杜]
好...好...好吧！
这...这些东西...没什么大不了的...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Then let's look around individually and send a signal when something of value is found.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
那我们分开行动吧，发现有价值线索时发出信号。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wa...wait!!
Wouldn't it be better to move together since it's dangerous?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
等...等等！！
这里很危险，一起行动不是更好吗？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Hey!
Look!
Don't leave me!
Hey!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
嘿！
看那边！
别丢下我！
嘿！！！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wait for me!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
等等我！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
What is this disgusting smell?
scripts.translation:
[马克]
这是什么恶心的味道？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
There are too many suspicious places...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
可疑的地方太多了...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Um...
You're here...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
嗯...
你在这里...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
I didn't send the signal yet but did you come here because you also got a strange feeling?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
我还没发信号，你是因为感觉到什么才来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
A long time ago...
...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
很久以前...
...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
No...no.
Let's call the others and start the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
不...不。
叫其他人过来，开始调查吧。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Investigate.
scripts.translation: 调查

scripts.text:
[Alph]
...
Don't forget our goal is to investigate...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
...
别忘了我们的目标是调查...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
I just sent out the signal so the others will arrive soon.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
我刚发了信号，其他人很快就会到。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Aaarghhhh!!!!
Get away you unctuous bastards!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
啊啊啊啊啊！！
滚开，你们这群恶心的家伙！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Be quiet...
scripts.translation:
[马克]
安静点...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Is there something special about this room?
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
这个房间有什么特别之处吗？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Oh! The woman at the entrance earlier?
Why are you at a dangerous place like this?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哦！是刚才在入口的那个女子？
你怎么会在这种危险的地方？

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Oh?
Did you not hear?
That..
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
哦？
你没听到吗？
那个...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Come to think of it that girl did say there would probably be a guide.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
说起来，那个女孩确实说过可能会有向导。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
....Um...
Was there...

[Mark]
Anyway it seems everybody is here so let's go in.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
总之，既然大家都到齐了，就进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Right...
There's a bad energy so be careful...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
好的...
这里有一股不祥的气息，请小心...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Is there more left to investigate in this room?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
这个房间里还有其他需要调查的地方吗？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text:
[Alph]
...
Don't forget our goal is to investigate...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
...
别忘了我们的目标是调查...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Right...
There's a bad energy so be careful...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
好的...
这里有一股不祥的气息，请小心...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
As expected..
Only this room has a different lay out than the rest...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
果然...
只有这个房间的布局与其他地方不同...

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I see.
There's a door that doesn't seem to belong in a very unnatural location.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我明白了。
有一扇门出现在非常不自然的位置。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...There is no other way but to go in and investigate ourselves?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
...看来除了进去调查，别无他法？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Charge!!!!!

[Alph]
Unnatural room... Unnatural door...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
不自然的房间...不自然的门...

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text:
[Alph]
...

[Alph]
Haa...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
哈...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
This space is suffocating.
My head is starting to throb already.
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
这个空间令人窒息。
我的头已经开始疼了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
What is this space?
It seems to be poorly built for it to be used as a bunker...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
这是什么地方？
作为掩体来说，建造得相当粗糙...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
The disgusting smell has gotten worse...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
那股恶臭越来越重了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
There looks to be another door there so let's check it out.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
那边好像还有一扇门，我们去看看吧。

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Verity]
...Should have brought some painkillers for headaches.
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
...真该带点止痛药治头痛的。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Are you quitting the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
你要放弃调查吗？

scripts.text: - Unable to enter the place -
scripts.translation: - 无法进入该地点 -

scripts.text: - Does not seem locked but blocked by something.-
scripts.translation: - 看起来没有上锁，但被什么东西挡住了。-

scripts.text: Break it.
scripts.translation: 打破它

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Du]
You want to leave a place like this alone?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
你想就这样离开这种地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Alright then....
One!
Two!
Three!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
好吧……
一！
二！
三！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wow...What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哇……这是什么地方？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
It is a really suspicious place...
I didn't think such a space would exist inside a bunker...
scripts.translation:
[马克]
这里真的很可疑……
我没想到地堡里面会有这样的空间……

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Ah...Ah...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
啊……啊……

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
It seems to be haphazardly made considering its use... Hm...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
考虑到它的用途，建造得似乎很随意……嗯……

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
The...door....
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
那……门……

scripts.text:
[Alph]
There is a kind of subtlety for it be a secret space...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
作为秘密空间，它有一种微妙的感觉……

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Door...door....
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
门……门……

scripts.text:
[Du]
Maggi what are you gaping about?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
玛姬，你在那发什么呆？

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
The...door is stuck.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
门……卡住了。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Eh?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
What?!?!?
scripts.translation:
[马克]
什么？！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Argh!!!
It's true?!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
啊！！！
是真的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Are we all trapped here?!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
我们都被困在这里了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Wa..wait let's think about this stoically.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
等……等等，让我们冷静地思考一下。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Oh no what do we do...
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
糟糕，我们该怎么办……

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Ah...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
啊……

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Since there is no way to get out, should we go further inside?
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
既然没有出去的路，我们要不要继续往里面走？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wait... Come to think Verity!
You say you are a guide and you don't know the way out?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
等等……仔细想想，薇丽蒂！
你自称是向导，却不知道出口在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Verity]
This is the first time for me go in this deep...
There is no other way!
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
这是我第一次走到这么深的地方……
没有别的路了！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wow...What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哇……这是什么地方？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
It is a really suspicious place...
I didn't think such a space would exist inside a bunker...
scripts.translation:
[马克]
这里真的很可疑……
我没想到地堡里面会有这样的空间……

scripts.text: There is a weird piece.
scripts.translation: 有一块奇怪的碎片。

scripts.text:
I cannot tell how long it has been since I entered this place.
In this darkness my sense of time grows dull and the people are quickly growing tired.
scripts.translation:
我已经记不清自己进入这里多久了。
在这黑暗中，我对时间的感知变得迟钝，大家也很快变得疲惫不堪。

scripts.text: They talk of escaping without knowing the outside situation... Is this the right choice?
scripts.translation: 他们在不了解外面情况的情况下谈论着逃脱……这是正确的选择吗？

scripts.text:
But we have already lost our way back.
Yes.... This was not an escape.
Merely fleeing to survive...
scripts.translation:
但我们已经迷失了回去的路。
是的……这并非逃脱。
只是为了生存而逃窜……

scripts.text: How long can we keep running?
scripts.translation: 我们还能这样跑多久？

scripts.text:
Even though I was ready for this, the situation is deteriorating.
I can only say I would not have survived if I stayed at that place.
scripts.translation:
尽管我早有准备，但情况正在恶化。
我只能说，如果当时留在那个地方，我肯定活不下来。

scripts.text: Hope...
scripts.translation: 希望……

scripts.text: Many have already become incapable of hope...
scripts.translation: 许多人已经无法抱有希望了……

scripts.text: We should have been out by now according to the calculations but there is only dirt still.
scripts.translation: 按照计算，我们现在应该已经出去了，但眼前依然只有泥土。

scripts.text:
The calculations could be wrong and we may be going in circles.
It doesn't feel right.
scripts.translation:
计算可能有误，我们也许只是在绕圈子。
感觉不对劲。

scripts.text:
No..
I haven't felt at ease since that day.
scripts.translation:
不……
从那天起，我就再也没有感到过安心。

scripts.text: There is a weird piece.
scripts.translation: 有一块奇怪的碎片。

scripts.text:
I may have reached my limits.
I must blame my overtaxed body for not listening to me now.
scripts.translation:
我可能已经到达极限了。
我必须责怪这过度劳累的身体，它现在不听使唤了。

scripts.text: The numbers of survivors are dwindling.
scripts.translation: 幸存者的数量正在减少。

scripts.text:
Like this...
I thought it was karma that I am witnessing the end...
Perhaps it is my selfishness.
I don't think there is no such time left for me..
scripts.translation:
就这样……
我曾以为这是命运，让我见证终结……
也许是我的自私。
我觉得自己已经没有时间了……

scripts.text: Even walking is difficult now.
scripts.translation: 现在连走路都很困难。

scripts.text:
Once I confidently claimed I will lead all of us...
I find myself pathetic for becoming a burden much less of help.
scripts.translation:
我曾自信地宣称会带领我们所有人……
如今发现自己不仅帮不上忙，反而成了累赘，真是可悲。

scripts.text:
Everything is regretful.
Everything I started...
Everything of mine...
scripts.translation:
一切都令人后悔。
我所开始的一切……
属于我的一切……

scripts.text: It would be better to abandon me...
scripts.translation: 把我抛弃掉……或许会更好……

scripts.text: The days I am asleep are outnumbering the days I am awake now.
scripts.translation: 如今，我沉睡的日子已经超过了清醒的日子。

scripts.text: I suddenly picture his face in my increasingly hazy consciousness.
scripts.translation: 在逐渐模糊的意识中，我忽然浮现出他的面容。

scripts.text: Tatio...
scripts.translation: 塔蒂奥……

scripts.text: A person sweet to me even though all I only cared about was my work.
scripts.translation: 尽管我只关心工作，他却对我如此温柔。

scripts.text:
Ha... person...
I cannot endure the shame of my past for considering him a mere successful project.'
scripts.translation:
哈……人……
回想起过去曾将他视为一个成功的项目，这份羞耻让我难以忍受。

scripts.text:
Though I cannot help that I may die here...
If only to apologize to him...
If only to muster one sweet word, I have thoughts of survival.
scripts.translation:
虽然我知道自己可能会死在这里……
如果能向他道歉……
如果能鼓起勇气说出一句温柔的话，我就有了求生的念头。

scripts.text: ..Is it possible?
scripts.translation: ……这有可能吗？

scripts.text: There is a weird piece.
scripts.translation: 有一块奇怪的碎片。

scripts.text: debugging
scripts.translation: 调试中

scripts.text:
File...error...restore...
Operation...range...25%...30%...35%.......
45%...50%... Minimal normal operations possible start safety mode operations
scripts.translation: 45%...50%... 启动安全模式，维持最低限度的正常运作

scripts.text: 60% movement speed normal. Bodily functions normal.
scripts.translation: 60% 移动速度恢复正常。身体机能正常。

scripts.text: 70% Most language function restored. Slight symptoms of septic anemia but it seems it will be fixed soon.
scripts.translation: 70% 大部分语言功能已恢复。有轻微的贫血症状，但似乎很快就能治愈。

scripts.text:
80% Surgery was fairly successful despite having had no proper preparations.
Planning to apply treatment to the rest of the survivors based on this success.
scripts.translation:
80% 尽管没有充分的准备，手术相当成功。
计划基于此次成功，对剩余的幸存者进行治疗。

scripts.text:
98% Corrupt sector detected.
For more effective operations I have copied the memory chip and constructed 'T_W_O_002b.'
There seems to have been some loss of data during the copying process...
scripts.translation:
98% 检测到损坏扇区。
为了更有效地运作，我复制了记忆芯片并构建了“T_W_O_002b”。
复制过程中似乎丢失了一些数据……

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务 -

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
... It seems the last survivors have lingered here...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
……看来最后的幸存者一直留在这里……

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I feel scared to open the next door for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
不知为何，我有些害怕打开下一扇门。

scripts.text: Open door.
scripts.translation: 打开门

scripts.text: Open door.
scripts.translation: 打开门

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
There is a bitter feeling of sorts...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
心中涌起一股苦涩的感觉...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Hello.
Are you here for the underground bunker investigation?
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
你好。
你是来调查地下碉堡的吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Use gravity safety device
scripts.translation: 使用重力安全装置

scripts.text:
[Verity]
It seems very dangerous below so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
下面似乎非常危险，请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
If you consider the appearance of monsters not seen in other areas, something is...
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
如果考虑到那些在其他区域从未见过的魔物，那么这里似乎...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
You can easily reach the entrance of the last room by using the gravity safety device.
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
使用重力安全装置可以轻易到达最后的房间的入口。

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
I see you do not have the gravity safety device with you.
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
看来你身上没有携带重力安全装置。

scripts.text: [Verity]
scripts.translation: [薇丽蒂]

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Is that so?
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
是吗？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, only permitted excavation team members are permitted access.
If you work hard with your current excavation team the permit will come.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，只有获准的挖掘团队成员才能进入。
如果你在当前挖掘团队中努力工作，许可很快就会下来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This place can only be accessed by permitted members.
Where are you coming from?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个地方只有获准的成员才能进入。
你是从哪里来的？

scripts.text: I am coming from the atnad excavation
scripts.translation: 我来自阿特纳德挖掘队

scripts.text: Why am I prohibited?
scripts.translation: 为什么我被禁止进入？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah. You are a member of the Atnad excavation team.
Yes I have confirmed you on the list.
Atnad excavators are permitted access.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊。你是阿特纳德挖掘队的成员。
是的，我在名单上确认过你。
阿特纳德的挖掘者获准进入。

scripts.text: Why is access prohibited?
scripts.translation: 为什么禁止进入？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Verus City is divided into four large sections.
Did you know?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
维鲁斯城分为四个主要区域。
你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The area currently open are the town and plaza.
While the reason is unknown this place has been closed off and prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前开放的区域是城镇和广场。
虽然原因不明，但这个地方已被封闭并禁止进入。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
During independent corporate investigations before excavator recruitment,
we found that there was a large explosion here and to check the safety of the area,
an inspection period was needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在招募挖掘者之前的独立公司调查中，
我们发现这里曾发生大爆炸，为了检查区域的安全性，
需要一段检查期。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is place currently not seen as a great risk other than the dangerous terrain and possibility of
being attacked by machines like the plaza, so access is limited only to the excavation team.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
除了危险的地形和像广场那样可能被机器攻击的风险外，
目前这个地方不被视为重大风险，因此仅限挖掘团队进入。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please note that the permit also includes the zone connected in the West.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请注意，通行证也包含西侧相连的区域。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, since you are permitted you may enter freely from now on.
Then I expect there to be good results!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，既然您已获得许可，从现在起可以自由进入。
期待您能取得良好的成果！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How is the research and investigation going?
The machines in the restricted area are quite dangerous so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
研究和调查进展如何？
限制区域内的机器相当危险，请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Scholar]
Hm.. This machine seems to be have been used for tracking something.
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔学者]
嗯……这台机器似乎被用于追踪某些东西。
你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Technician]
I think so as well.
This screen probably indicates the position or condition of what it is tracking or detecting.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔技师]
我也这么认为。
这个屏幕可能显示的是它正在追踪或检测的目标的位置或状态。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Scholar]
Was it showing the situation of this closed area, perhaps?
It is presumed that it was impossible to directly enter based on the interior situation a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔学者]
也许是在显示这个封闭区域的情况？
根据之前的内部情况推测，当时应该是无法直接进入的。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Technician]
Probably so.
We can assume there was a large explosion just by observation with our eyes..
Then the reason for the people outside to install something like this ....
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔技师]
很有可能。
仅凭肉眼观察，我们就能推断出这里发生过巨大的爆炸……
那么，外面的人安装这种东西的原因……

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Scholar]
Yes. It is to find out the interior situation.
Maybe.. there was a big accident so it might be for searching for survivors..
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔学者]
是的，是为了查明内部的情况。
也许……因为发生了重大事故，所以是为了搜救幸存者……

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Technician]
Indeed. You are probably right.
And our role is to find out the secrets of what happened here.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔技师]
确实如此。你说得对。
而我们的职责，就是查明这里发生的一切真相。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Hey, Kobell. If we want to be chosen as an outstanding excavation team...!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
嘿，科贝尔。如果我们想成为优秀的挖掘团队……！

scripts.text:
[Kobell]
To be..?
scripts.translation:
[科贝尔]
成为……？

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Is to figure out the identity of these unknown mechanical devices!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
就要弄清楚这些未知机械装置的来历！

scripts.text:
[Kobell]
Whaat? How did this happen?
We didn't even major in engineering!
scripts.translation:
[科贝尔]
什……什么？怎么会这样？
我们甚至没有主修工程学啊！

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
This place if full of machines! We can receive recognition like the Atnad excavators if we analyze them!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
这里到处都是机器！如果我们能解析它们，就能像阿特纳德的挖掘者那样获得认可！

scripts.text:
[Kobell]
Aha! Indeed so.
But I think the Atnad excavators are around here...?
scripts.translation:
[科贝尔]
啊哈！确实如此。
不过我觉得阿特纳德的挖掘者好像就在这附近……？

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Hah! Our research goals cannot be discovered. This is a secret between you and I!
scripts.translation:
[塞西尔]
哈！我们的研究目标不能被发现。这是我们俩之间的秘密！

scripts.text:
[Kobell]
Let's do that~
scripts.translation:
[科贝尔]
那就这么办吧~

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I am Monthly Brigan's senior reporter Krotzel! As this place is revealed to the many, many Adventurers are gathering here.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我是《布里刊》的资深记者克罗策尔！随着这个地方被公开，许多冒险者正聚集到这里。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I am most worried about the Probationary member. He is still new so won't know anything. It is highly possible he followed the veteran senior. If it is okay, can you find him?
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我最担心的是那位见习成员。他资历尚浅，什么都不知道。很有可能他跟随了那位资深前辈。如果方便的话，你能帮我找到他吗？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
If she followed the veteran senior she might have gone to the ruined area. If you find her please let me know where she is.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
如果她跟随了那位资深前辈，可能去了废墟区域。如果你找到她，请告诉我她的位置。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
As I thought. I am glad he is at least safe. If it's okay can you find my colleague Sunny Kim as well?
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
果然如此。他至少平安无事，这让我松了口气。如果方便的话，能帮我找一下我的同事桑尼·金吗？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
We got along well since joining and eventually made a team together so I cannot help but be worried.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我们入行后相处得很好，最终还组成了搭档，所以我实在忍不住担心。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I don't think it can be helped that people will worry. The last veteran reporter, Grizzly Grylls! Designated survival reporter!
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
大家担心也是人之常情。上一任资深记者，格里尔斯！那位被指定为“生存记者”的人！

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Find me Grizzly Grylls, veteran reporter who can survive anywhere. I think he may be in the ruins to the east...
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
请帮我找到格里尔斯，那位能在任何地方生存下来的资深记者。我想他可能在东边的废墟里...

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Good! So everybody is safe. Everybody will create a news item on their own, right?
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
太好了！看来大家都平安无事。大家都会各自撰写新闻稿，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
You're the adventurer I met last time! Our team members still haven't returned so I am worried. If it's okay, can you check if they are safe?
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
你是上次我遇到的那位冒险者！我的团队成员还没回来，我很担心。如果方便的话，能帮我确认一下他们是否安全吗？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I should check if everybody is safe. Please find and see if all three are working hard.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我应该确认一下大家是否安全。请找到他们，看看这三位是否都在努力工作。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Well we are all safe today. Because we are Adventure team 2! Thank you for helping!
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
好吧，今天大家都平安无事。毕竟我们是冒险团队2！谢谢你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
[Krotzel]
I should check if everybody is safe.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
[克罗策尔]
我应该确认一下大家是否安全。

scripts.text: [Krotzel]
scripts.translation: [克罗策尔]

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
It seems they are still working. I'm worried but I should be focusing on my work! We are the monthly Brigan Adventure team 2!
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
看来他们还在工作。虽然我很担心，但我应该专注于自己的工作！我们是《布里刊》的冒险团队2！

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Not a lot of information has been relayed to general Adventurers. So we are interviewing Adventurers ourselves! Doing the legwork and gathering information.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
传达给普通冒险者的信息并不多。所以我们要亲自采访冒险者！亲自跑腿收集情报。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Please give us good information if you have it. If it is a good piece of info we can give you a small reward.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
如果您有好的情报，请提供给我们。如果是很有价值的情报，我们可以给您一点小奖励。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Who are we? We are Monthly Brigan's Adventure team 2...
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我们是谁？我们是《布里刊》的冒险团队2...

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
...?
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
...？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Where did everybody go? Ha these pains in the butt! Adventure team 2 consists of two senior reporters, one veteran and one Probationary reporter for a total of four.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
大家都去哪儿了？哈，这些让人头疼的家伙！冒险团队2由两名资深记者、一名老手和一名见习记者组成，总共四人。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I am in charge of interviews and arranging stories and my colleague is photographs. Veteran senior acts as a guide. As a magazine specializing in Adventure we go to cover dangerous places a lot.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我负责采访和编排稿件，我的同事负责摄影。资深前辈担任向导。作为一本专注于冒险的杂志，我们经常去报道危险的地方。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
While I am not completely lacking combat experience my forte is reporting! But where did everybody really go? One might think we're on a picnic!
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
虽然我的战斗经验不算完全缺乏，但我的专长是报道！但大家到底去哪儿了？还以为我们在野餐呢！

scripts.text: Look for Probationary reporter
scripts.translation: 寻找见习记者

scripts.text: Too busy
scripts.translation: 太忙了

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Thank you so much. If he followed the veteran senior he might have gone to the ruined area. I saw his limpid eyes looking at the senior.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
非常感谢。如果他跟着资深前辈走的话，可能去了废墟区域。我刚才看到他清澈的眼睛正望着前辈。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I will look around in this area. You don't have to bring him. Even though it's the Probationary period he should know how to work by himself! Just let me know where he is when you find him.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我会在这一带找找看。你不用带他。虽然还在见习期，但他应该知道怎么独立工作！找到他后告诉我他在哪里就行。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
We got along well since joining and eventually made a team together so I cannot help but be worried.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我们入行后相处得很好，最终还组成了搭档，所以我实在忍不住担心。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
She started singing about the architecture style as soon as she came here so she will be around this area.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
她刚到这里就开始哼唱关于建筑风格的歌了，所以应该就在这附近。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
He started to sing about the architecture style as soon as he came here so he will be around this area. I beg you.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
他刚到这里就开始哼唱关于建筑风格的歌了，所以应该就在这附近。拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
The nickname stuck because he survived anywhere but honestly he has no talent in combat. He is just lucky.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
这个绰号之所以叫得响，是因为他无论在哪里都能活下来，但说实话他在战斗方面没什么天赋。他只是运气好。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Although I think he will be safe... can you find out where about he is? He probably ran to the ruins there...
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
虽然我觉得他应该没事...你能帮我找找他在哪吗？他可能跑到那边的废墟去了...

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Come to think of it he's similar to a guild master I interviewed a while back. The fact that he jumps into danger and comes back no matter what... Easier to avoid danger in the first place!
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
仔细想想，他有点像我之前采访过的一位公会会长。那种不顾一切跳入危险又总能回来的劲头...其实一开始就避开危险不是更好吗！

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
If they don't return tomorrow I should look for them.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
如果他们明天还没回来，我就得去找他们了。

scripts.text: Look for team members
scripts.translation: 寻找团队成员

scripts.text: Right now is not a good time
scripts.translation: 现在不是时候

scripts.text: Converse
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
They all have a professional mindset so if they haven't finished working just see if they are safe.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
他们都有职业精神，如果还没完成工作，只要确认他们安全就好。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I will wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
What is monthly Brigan? You know. Booty that can be obtained from monsters. It is not a jewel but it can provide quite an income. It is like sweet rain to an Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
什么是月度布里刊？你知道的。就是从魔物身上获得的战利品。它不是宝石，但能带来不错的收入。对于冒险者来说，这就好比甘霖。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
The boss' goal is that. Not the jackpot for an Adventurer but let's make a magazine that can provide sweet info! That's kind of the purpose apparently.
scripts.translation:
[克罗策尔]
老板的目标就是这个。不是为了给冒险者带来大奖，而是做一本能提供甜美资讯的杂志！这大概就是它的宗旨吧。

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
Monthly Brigan's senior photo journalist...Ahah! Monsters keep coming! It's dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
月度布里刊的资深摄影记者...啊哈哈！魔物一直涌过来！太危险了！

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
Krotzel? Ah you mean my partner. I still have to capture the cool architecture style and monsters. Tell her I am fine.
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
克罗策尔？啊，你说的是我的搭档。我还需要拍摄酷炫的建筑风格和魔物。告诉她我没事。

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
I thought I worked a lot on the ground but I am impressed! I will capture all of it in my palm!
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
我以为我在地上工作已经够多了，但看到这些我还是很惊讶！我要把它们全部拍进我的镜头里！

scripts.text: Ask if safe
scripts.translation: 询问是否安全

scripts.text: Is there anything to help with?
scripts.translation: 有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Converse
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
How is this incredible architecture underground? The more I know the more curious I am.
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
地下的建筑竟然如此不可思议？我了解得越多，就越感到好奇。

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
Of course! I have struggled a lot at the bottom! I am still taking photos. Tell her I will go when I am ready.
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
当然！我在下面可是费了不少劲！我还在拍照呢。告诉她，等我准备好了就下去。

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
Do you have any thoughts on helping me as a righteous Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
作为正义的冒险者，你有什么想法能帮到我吗？

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
So you have to stand there and take care of the monsters! With dynamic and large movements if possible! Photographs need a proper concept.
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
所以你要站在那里，负责清理魔物！动作要尽量大一点，要有动感！照片需要恰当的主题。

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
Thanks to you, I think a great piece of work will be produced! I will go back to taking building photos.
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
多亏了你，我想一定能拍出很棒的作品！我要回去继续拍建筑了。

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
I took a lot of photos but I need time to confirm them. Some of them may be out of focus or I may need better photos, so next time.
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
我拍了很多照片，但需要时间确认一下。有些可能失焦了，或者需要更好的角度，所以下次再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
[Sunny Kim]
I can't always take great photos. Photography is about instants. But you can save the moment for a long time. That is the beauty of photography!
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
[桑尼·金]
我不可能每次都拍出完美的照片。摄影讲究的是瞬间。但你可以将这一刻长久地保存下来。这就是摄影的美妙之处！

scripts.text: Help Photo Journalist Sunny Kim
scripts.translation: 帮助摄影记者桑尼·金

scripts.text: Decline
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
Photographing cool structures, dynamic monsters and an Adventurer! I am taking photos with two themes but you can help me with one!
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
拍摄酷炫的建筑、充满动感的魔物，还有冒险者！我有两个拍摄主题，你可以帮我其中一个！

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
Take care of the surrounding monsters for me. I will capture it in photos! Then I can photograph the area in peace!
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
帮我清理一下周围的魔物。我会把它们拍下来！这样我就能安心地拍摄这个区域了！

scripts.text:
[Sunny Kim]
I can't always take great photos. Photography is about instants. But you can save the moment for a long time. That is the beauty of photography!
scripts.translation:
[桑尼·金]
我不可能每次都拍出完美的照片。摄影讲究的是瞬间。但你可以将这一刻长久地保存下来。这就是摄影的美妙之处！

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
Haha are you an Adventurer? I am Grizzly Grylls! A reporter who likes adventure.
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
哈哈，你是冒险者吗？我是暴焰野熊格里尔斯！一个喜欢冒险的记者。

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
Krotzel is concerned? Don't joke. I am veteran reporter Grizzly Grylls! I am enjoying an adventure! Tell her to not worry.
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
克罗策尔担心什么？别开玩笑了。我是资深记者暴焰野熊格里尔斯！我正在享受冒险！告诉她别担心。

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
Now I am confused whether I am a reporter or an adventurer. I even got the nickname survival king for being able to survive anywhere!
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
现在我都分不清自己是记者还是冒险者了。我甚至因为能在任何地方生存而得了“生存之王”的绰号！

scripts.text: Ask if safe
scripts.translation: 询问是否安全

scripts.text: Is there anything to help with?
scripts.translation: 有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Converse
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
Other than this place being more dangerous than I thought! I am hungry from diligently running away. I wish there was something to eat.
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
除了这里比我想象的更危险之外！我拼命逃跑跑得肚子都饿了。真希望有点吃的。

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
I am enjoying an adventure! Tell her to not worry. I am a little hungry though...
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
我正在享受冒险！告诉她别担心。不过我有点饿了...

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
This isn't a big deal but do you have some time?
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
这不是什么大事，但你有点时间吗？

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
A bug that gnaws away metal. I wonder how it tastes. I am so curious! This is why I can't quit being a reporter.
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
一种能啃食金属的虫子。我想知道它尝起来是什么味道。我太好奇了！这就是为什么我当不了记者。

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
I will cook now! I am salivating at the thought of the flavor!
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
我要开始烹饪了！一想到那个味道我就流口水了！

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
I am a little busy cooking these bugs. You want a bite as well?
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
我正忙着烹饪这些虫子。你也想尝一口吗？

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
[Grylls]
Amazing that there are bugs that gnaw at metal! But they must be a good source of precious protein and high in nutrition!
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
[格里尔斯]
居然有能啃食金属的虫子，太不可思议了！但它们一定是优质的蛋白质来源，营养很高！

scripts.text: Help survival reporter Grylls
scripts.translation: 帮助生存记者格里尔斯

scripts.text: Decline
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
I haven't been able to eat at all from all the running away. All day! I noticed these bugs that eat metal.
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
因为一直忙着逃跑，我整天都没吃东西。我注意到这些吃金属的虫子了。

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
I need to taste these bugs. I think it will be a good news story as well! The survival king's roasted metal bugs! That's the headline!
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
我得尝尝这些虫子。我觉得这也会是个不错的新闻素材！“生存之王的烤金属虫”！这就是标题！

scripts.text:
[Grylls]
Amazing that there are bugs that gnaw at metal! But they must be a good source of precious protein and high in nutrition!
scripts.translation:
[格里尔斯]
居然有能啃食金属的虫子，太不可思议了！但它们一定是优质的蛋白质来源，营养很高！

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
Hello! I am Rookie reporter Trapp! Of Monthly Brigan's Adventure Team 2! I will cover the stories even through danger!
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
你好！我是《布里刊》冒险团队2号的新人记者特拉普！即使面对危险，我也会报道新闻的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
Hello! I am Trapp! The newest member of Monthly Brigan's Adventure team 2! My senior is worried? I will cover this story and return!
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
你好！我是特拉普！《布里刊》冒险团队2号的新成员！前辈很担心我？我会报道完这条新闻就回去的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
Please tell her to not worry so much! I am a reporter too now! However if you have the time I would like you to help me with something. I mean later.
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
请告诉她别太担心！我现在也是记者了！不过如果你有时间的话，我想请你帮个忙。我是说之后。

scripts.text: Ask if safe
scripts.translation: 询问是否安全

scripts.text: Is there anything to help with?
scripts.translation: 有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Converse
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
Grylls is nicknamed survival king! Because he survives even in the most extreme areas! I want to become a cool reporter like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
格里尔斯的绰号是“生存之王”！因为他即使在最极端的环境也能生存下来！我想成为像他那样酷的记者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
She is really concerned about me! Tell her as soon as Grylls' work is done I will follow!
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
她真的很担心我！请告诉她，等格里尔斯的工作结束后我就跟上去！

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
I mustered some courage and followed him but it was dangerous. If it's okay can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
我鼓起勇气跟上了他，但那里很危险。如果可以的话，你能帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
Because of the nickname survival king, I thought Grizzly was good in combat but he is really just good at surviving. As soon as monsters showed up he disappeared like the wind.
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
因为“生存之王”这个绰号，我以为格里尔斯很擅长战斗，但他其实只是擅长生存。魔物一出现，他就像风一样消失了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
Did you eradicate that much already? I am not done yet but thank you!
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
你已经消灭了那么多吗？我还没做完，但谢谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
I am fighting hard to become a specialized survival reporter! Even though...not now but please come back later, if that's okay with you!
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
我正在努力成为一名专业的生存记者！虽然...现在不行，但请稍后再来，如果你不介意的话！

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
[Rookie Reporter]
Realizing the world's truth and justice is the mission of the reporter! We have to protect those two despite any hardship and environment!
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
[新人记者]
揭示世界的真相与正义是记者的使命！无论面临多大的困难和环境，我们都必须守护这两者！

scripts.text: Help Rookie reporter Trapp
scripts.translation: 帮助新人记者特拉普

scripts.text: Decline
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
Please eradicate the monsters for me! I am trying my best but I am still not used to this. I beg of you.
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
请帮我消灭那些魔物！我已经尽力了，但我还不太习惯。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie Reporter]
Realizing the world's truth and justice is the mission of the reporter! We have to protect those two despite any hardship and environment!
scripts.translation:
[新人记者]
揭示世界的真相与正义是记者的使命！无论面临多大的困难和环境，我们都必须守护这两者！

[Nile]
I just.. Don't want to let it be known I am there..
If you have business, let's meet officially in the Eden Group office.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
我只是...不想让人知道我在这里...
如果你有公事，请在乐园团的办公室正式会面。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Do you not remember what I told you at the office?
I said if you want to play it, you need at least five.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
你不记得我在办公室告诉你的话吗？
我说如果你想玩这个，至少需要五个。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Did you bring it?
Good. Put them together like this...
Put it here...
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
你带来了？
很好。像这样把它们拼在一起...
放在这里...

scripts.text:
[Nile]
It's the table right here.
I set it up so you can operate it.
You just have to play it.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
就是这张桌子。
我设置好了，你可以操作它。
你只需要播放它。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
...The content is not a big deal.
Why.. is the name Atnad mentioned?
Does the old man know too?
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
...内容不是什么大事。
为什么...提到了阿特纳德的名字？
那个老人也知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
You remember the gist right?
Just go and report it.
Tell him I will collect the items myself.
He will probably have no problem.
Since the old man is soooooo superior.
scripts.translation:
[尼罗]
你记得大概的意思吧？
去报告一下。
告诉他我会亲自去取那些物品。
他应该不会有意见。
毕竟那个老人那么高高在上。

scripts.text:

scripts.text: Ah- This cozy and snug fe...el.....ling
scripts.translation: 啊...这种舒适而温馨的感觉...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
First congratulations on surviving. I'm glad you got into the air-raid shelter. If you were outside..
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
首先恭喜你还活着。很高兴你躲进了防空洞。如果你在外面...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
...
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Whew.. even thinking about it makes me dizzy. Both of us were lucky. Don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
呼...光是想想就让我头晕。我们两个都挺幸运的，你觉得呢？

scripts.text: I think so too.
scripts.translation: 我也这么觉得。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I feel a lot of sympathy though. It looks like a lot of people are blaming this explosion on Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
不过我挺同情的。看起来很多人都在把这次爆炸归咎于弗雷萨。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
The explosion can't be only Lona's responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
这次爆炸不能只由洛娜一个人负责。

scripts.text: Lona?
scripts.translation: 洛娜？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
A great person for sure despite failing the experiment.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
尽管实验失败了，她绝对是个了不起的人。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
She took charge of figuring out the number of survivors in that confusing mess of a situation.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
在那种混乱的局面中，她主动承担起统计幸存者数量的工作。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
If it was me...
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
如果是我...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I would probably be wandering around without knowing what do to right about now..
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
我现在大概正不知所措地四处游荡吧...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ugh- I guess even I should go and help. Want to help?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
唉——我想我也应该去帮忙。你想一起去吗？

scripts.text: Agree to help.
scripts.translation: 同意帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Really? You will help? What a relief because I wasn't confident about going by myself.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
真的吗？你会帮忙？太好了，因为我自己去的话心里没底。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There is a researcher with a cold demeanor in the center of this room, right?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
这个房间中央有一位神情冷淡的研究员，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
She is the head of the experiment, Lona Fresa. People usually call her Dr. Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
她是这次实验的负责人，洛娜·弗雷萨。大家通常叫她弗雷萨博士。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Do you want to go and ask her if she needs any help?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
你想去问问她是否需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There is a researcher with a cold demeanor in the center of this room, right?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
这个房间中央有一位神情冷淡的研究员，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Do you want to go and ask her if she needs any help?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
你想去问问她是否需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I was asked to find out how many are capable of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
我被要求去调查有多少人具备烹饪能力。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
We have to try hard even though the air-raid shelter is complex and wide.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
虽然防空洞结构复杂且面积很大，但我们必须努力寻找。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Thanks for helping her.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
谢谢你的帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Is it because we helped? I thought I saw a faint smile on her face.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
是因为我们帮忙了吗？我好像看到她脸上浮现出一丝淡淡的微笑。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Uh?! I don't think I've seen you before in the air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
咦？我好像没在防空洞里见过你吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ah! Are you the Adventurer who's helping with moving the newly made air cleaning unit?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
啊！你是那位正在协助搬运新制空气净化装置的冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
You are working a lot because of those thoughtless Mechanicians.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
因为那些鲁莽的机械师，你可是忙坏了。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
The Bioengineers succeeded in cultivating grapes right?
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
听说生物工程师们成功培育出了葡萄？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
They say at least one grape harvest every 2 weeks is possible? The harvest day is probably either today or tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
据说每两周至少能收获一次？收获日应该就在今天或明天。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I want to taste fresh grapes soon. I've been eating only dry food for the past few days.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
我好想快点尝尝鲜摘葡萄。这几天我都在吃干粮。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There's a rumor going around in the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
防空洞里流传着一个谣言。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
A while ago the Chemical Substance Specialist and a few others went outside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
不久前，化学专家和其他几个人曾离开过防空洞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Apparently some contaminated substance got inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
据说某种受污染的物质进入了防空洞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I heard the number of convulsing patients are rapidly increasing because of the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
我听说因为这种污染物，抽搐病人的数量正在迅速增加。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ah! It's just a rumor! A Rumor!!
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
啊！这只是谣言！是谣言！！

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
It seems the rumor going around was true.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
看来流传的谣言是真的。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I hear they are moving supplies to the clean Zone Z-2 even though it's newly opened because of the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
听说由于污染物的影响，尽管Z-2区是新开放的洁净区，他们还是要把物资转移过去。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I think I will lend a hand even just a little.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
我想我也许可以帮上一点忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Nice to meet you, my name is Bunker Sayhu.
scripts.translation:
[掩体 赛胡]
幸会，我是掩体 赛胡。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I am sorry. Right now I am a little busy with several problems. Can we speak later?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
抱歉。我现在正忙着处理几个问题。我们稍后再对话好吗？

scripts.text: No! What I mean..
scripts.translation: 不！我的意思是...

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
What?! The Adventurer wants to help me?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
什么？！这位冒险者想帮我？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good. The people are uncontrollable because they are shocked and confused.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
很好。人们因为震惊和困惑而难以控制。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
If the intimidating Adventurer helps out it will be easier to control the confused masses.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
如果有这位令人敬畏的冒险者帮忙，控制这些惊慌失措的人群就会容易得多。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good!! I approve. Just in time for a troublesome problem as well.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
很好！！我批准了。正好我也遇到一个棘手的问题。

scripts.text: Troublesome problem?
scripts.translation: 棘手的问题？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The personnel with various specialties such as yourself have not changed their positions and are easy to grasp, but the other employees are the problem.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
像您这样拥有各种专业技能的人员并没有改变位置，情况很容易掌握，但其他员工才是问题所在。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Surely they are moving according to the Emergency Situation Guidelines of their respective teams.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷萨]
他们肯定是在按照各自团队的紧急情况指南行动。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I cannot figure out from here where they are and what they are doing.
scripts.translation:

So I was thinking if you

scripts.translation:

尽管在这个庞大且复杂的避难所里这并不容易，但我还是请求你帮这个忙。

scripts.translation:

什么？！你已经回来了？你比我预想的回来得早。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
An adventure to move the air cleaner?
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
要移动空气净化器的冒险任务？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
You look solid just like the other researchers mentioned. I bet you can lift the air cleaner like nothing!!
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
你看起来很有力气，就像其他研究员说的那样。我敢打赌你能轻松举起空气净化器！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We shouldn't be ordering people like you who got caught up in an accident, but the situation is urgent.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
我们不应该命令像你这样卷入事故的人，但情况很紧急。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We made a new air cleaning unit because the one operating previously broke down a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
因为之前运行的空气净化器坏了，我们制造了一台新的空气净化单元。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We should have made it in modular form. Made it as one solid piece by mistake.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
本来应该做成模块化的。结果不小心做成了一个整体。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Didn't think of it when we were making it!!
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
制造的时候没想到这一点！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
It happens. Right?
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Facilities managers are making a fuss about needing the air cleaning unit soon.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]

scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We could make the machine that can transport it if we had more time..
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
So we ended up asking the strong Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
所以我们只好求助于强壮的冒险者。

scripts.text: Yes sir.
scripts.translation: 遵命，长官。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Aren't you refreshing!!
scripts.translation:
[机械师 穆格奥西]
你真是令人耳目一新！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
